formulas.name: choose_next_status
formulas.expression: If({!choose_current_status}="Approval Requested" && {!Approve_decline_toggle.value}=true, "Planned", If({!choose_current_status}="Approval Requested" && {!Approve_decline_toggle.value}=false, "Request Declined", If({!choose_current_status}="Planned" && {!Approve_decline_toggle.value}=true, "Ordered", If({!choose_current_status}="Planned" && {!Approve_decline_toggle.value}=false, "Request Declined", If({!choose_current_status}="Ordered" && {!Mark_Plaque_was_Installed}=true, "Installed", TEXT({!get_plaque_in_approval_process.Status__c}))))))

formulas.name: pending_approval_formula
formulas.expression: IF({!choose_current_status} = "Approval Requested", "Pending approval of Financial Coordinator", IF({!choose_current_status} = "Planned", "Pending approval of Production Coordinator", IF({!choose_current_status} = "Ordered", "Waiting installment confirmation by Production Coordinator", "")))

formulas.name: user_picker
formulas.expression: CASE({!$UserRole.Name}, "Desk Manger USA", "desk", "Desk Manager Spanish", "desk", "Desk Manager Partnerships and Global Campaigns", "desk", "Desk Manager Israel", "desk", "Desk Manager European", "desk", "Desk Manager English", "desk", "CRM Manager", "financial", "Plaque Manager", "production", "Salesforce Adminisrator", "desk", "")
